text:
Type: tall bright blue four-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and small items; bedroom, children's room, hallway
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, retro
Materials: blue painted fiberboard in a smooth matte finish
Colors: bright azure blue
Shape: narrow upright chest of four equal drawers, flush handleless fronts with slim gaps as grips, flat top, straight square legs, slim and light
Feel: bold, cheerful, playful, fresh
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, yellow or white accents; playful modern bedrooms or children's rooms
